title: Harness of Minervini v2 ticker.fundamentals response

examples: MINERVINI_SEC_USER_AGENT='Name email@example.com' scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline ticker fundamentals AAPL
MINERVINI_SEC_USER_AGENT='Name email@example.com' scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline ticker fundamentals AAPL --as-of 2026-08-14 --cik 0000320193

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

cik.description: Stable SEC CIK of at most ten digits; required for historical --as-of.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

limitations: SEC facts are selected by filed_at, never period end alone.
Current ticker-to-CIK lookup is not used for historical identity; provide --cik.
Power Play may waive only unavailable verified fundamentals, never integrity, dilution, market, setup, eligibility, or risk controls.
The current SEC adapter reads the recent submissions index and discloses that older index files were not fetched.
x-capability-contract.output: Filed-as-of growth and integrity evidence, leader category, discrepancies, missing facts, and fundamentals convergence state.

status_meanings.needs_input: Historical identity or another required argument is missing.
status_meanings.ok: Filed evidence supports or contradicts convergence, or a fully proven exception applies.
status_meanings.partial: Filed evidence exists but required facts are incomplete.
status_meanings.unavailable: SEC evidence could not be obtained after one retry.

x-capability-contract.summary: Evaluate filed growth, revenue and margin confirmation, accounting integrity, dilution, leadership profile, and the narrow Power Play exception.
